items.source: Pattern matching can be done with PathMatcher or with parsed PathPatterns. The syntax is largely the same with the latter being more tailored for web usage and more efficient. The choice depends on the presence of a resolved String lookupPath or a parsed RequestPath which in turn depends on the HandlerMapping that matched the current request.
items.translation: 可以使用 `PathMatcher` 或解析后的 `PathPattern` 进行模式匹配。两者的语法大体相同，但后者更适用于 Web 场景且效率更高。选择取决于是否存在已解析的 `resolved` String 查找路径或已解析的 `parsed` RequestPath，而这又取决于匹配当前请求的 `HandlerMapping`。

items.source: Cache settings may be configured for specific URLs via path pattern with addCacheMapping(CacheControl, String...) and setCacheMappings(Properties), along with a fallback on default settings for all URLs via WebContentGenerator.setCacheControl(CacheControl).
items.translation: 可以通过路径模式为特定 URL 配置缓存设置，使用addCacheMapping(CacheControl, String...)和setCacheMappings(Properties)，同时通过WebContentGenerator.setCacheControl(CacheControl)为所有 URL 提供默认设置的回退。

items.source: Note: Setting PathMatcher enforces use of String pattern matching even when a parsed RequestPath is available.
items.translation: 注意： 设置 PathMatcher 会强制使用字符串模式匹配，即使存在已解析的parsed RequestPath。

items.source: All the settings supported by this interceptor can also be set on AbstractController. This interceptor is mainly intended for applying checks and preparations to a set of controllers mapped by a HandlerMapping.
items.translation: 此拦截器支持的所有设置也可以在 AbstractController 上设置。该拦截器主要用于对由 HandlerMapping 映射的一组控制器应用检查和准备操作。

items.source: NOTE: Path patterns are not supposed to overlap. If a request matches several mappings, it is effectively undefined which one will apply (due to the lack of key ordering in java.util.Properties).
items.translation: 注意：路径模式不应重叠。如果请求匹配多个映射，由于java.util.Properties缺乏键排序，实际上无法确定哪一个会生效。

items.source:
DispatcherServlet processes a handler in an execution chain, consisting
of any number of interceptors, with the handler itself at the end.
With this method, each interceptor can decide to abort the execution chain,
typically sending an HTTP error or writing a custom response.
items.translation: DispatcherServlet 处理一个执行链中的处理器，该执行链由任意数量的拦截器组成，处理器本身位于末尾。通过此方法，每个拦截器都可以决定中止执行链，通常发送 HTTP 错误或写入自定义响应。
